description: Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network interact and collect requests on edge.adobedc.net and server.adobedc.net. AppMeasurement /b/ss/ is vendor/adobe-analytics.

params.name: datastreamId
params.description: It is the datastream ID. Adobe documents `datastreamId` on v2. v1 uses `configId`.
params.fix_hint: Set `datastreamId` to the Datastream ID from the Adobe Experience Platform UI.

params.name: requestId
params.description: It is an external request tracing ID. Adobe documents `requestId` on interact and collect.
params.fix_hint: Send `requestId`, or drop the empty pair and let Edge generate one.

params.name: silent
params.description: It asks collect to return 204 with an empty body. Adobe documents a boolean query parameter.

params.name: xdm.timestamp
params.description: It is the ExperienceEvent timestamp. Adobe documents it as an ISO 8601 date-time.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2017-09-26T15:52:25+00:00`.

params.name: xdm.eventType
params.description: It names the experience event. Adobe documents `eventType` on the XDM ExperienceEvent.

params.name: xdm.identityMap
params.description: It holds namespaces and identity values. Adobe documents `identityMap` on the XDM ExperienceEvent. An empty object matches nobody.
params.fix_hint: Send at least one namespace in `xdm.identityMap`, or omit the field.

params.name: xdm.web.webPageDetails.URL
params.description: It is the normative page URL. Adobe documents `web.webPageDetails.URL` as an RFC 3986 URI.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `xdm.web.webPageDetails.URL`, or omit the field.

params.name: xdm.web.webPageDetails.name
params.description: It is the normative page name. Adobe documents `web.webPageDetails.name` for classification.
params.fix_hint: Send `xdm.web.webPageDetails.name`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: xdm.web.webPageDetails.siteSection
params.description: It is the site section for the page. Adobe documents `web.webPageDetails.siteSection`.
params.fix_hint: Send `xdm.web.webPageDetails.siteSection`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: xdm.web.webPageDetails.isErrorPage
params.description: It flags an error page. Adobe documents `web.webPageDetails.isErrorPage` as a boolean.

params.name: xdm.web.webPageDetails.isHomePage
params.description: It flags a home page. Adobe documents `web.webPageDetails.isHomePage` as a boolean.

params.name: xdm.web.webInteraction.URL
params.description: It is the link URL for an in-page interaction. Adobe documents `web.webInteraction.URL`.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `xdm.web.webInteraction.URL`, or omit the field.

params.name: xdm.web.webInteraction.name
params.description: It is the normative name of the web link. Adobe documents `web.webInteraction.name`.
params.fix_hint: Send `xdm.web.webInteraction.name`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: xdm.web.webInteraction.type
params.description: It is the link type. Adobe documents `download`, `exit`, or `other`.

params.name: xdm.web.webInteraction.linkClicks.value
params.description: It is the link-click measure. Adobe documents `linkClicks` as a measure with a numeric value.
params.fix_hint: Send `xdm.web.webInteraction.linkClicks.value` as a number, such as `1`.
